entries.title: Helping older adults use AI in everyday life
entries.summary: OpenAI and AARP are bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to 1,000 older adults across 10 U.S. cities to build practical AI skills safely.

entries.title: Reimagining advertising with AI
entries.summary: Explore new AI-powered advertising experiences from OpenAI, including Sponsored Agents, tools for marketers, and integrations with HubSpot and Shopify.

entries.title: How Fyxer built an AI executive assistant people trust
entries.summary: Fyxer uses OpenAI models, fine-tuning, memory, and real user feedback to organize inboxes and draft emails in each user’s voice.

entries.title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
entries.summary: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.

entries.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users
entries.summary: Learn how OpenAI evolved Habitat from a Python library into a globally distributed storage platform serving 1 billion ChatGPT users and 22M requests per second.

entries.title: Cognition helps Devin test its own work with GPT‑6 Astra
entries.summary: GPT‑6 Astra improves Devin’s ability to test software and show that it works, with the goal of helping engineers review less code and ship more.

entries.title: How a researcher uses Codex and ChatGPT to search for new antimicrobial molecules
entries.summary: César de la Fuente’s lab uses Codex and ChatGPT to search living and extinct genomes for antimicrobial candidates to fight drug-resistant infections.

entries.title: Now everyone can put data to work
entries.summary: Meet the Data agent in ChatGPT Work. Connect company data, uncover insights, and build interactive dashboards with AI using natural language.

entries.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services
entries.summary: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services, combining built-in financial data and GPT-6 Astra for research, modeling, and client-ready materials.

entries.title: Expanding AI access and cyber defense for federal, state, local, and tribal governments
entries.summary: OpenAI and GSA will offer eligible federal, state, local, and tribal governments $0 license fees, 50% off usage, and expanded cyber defense support.
